column1: # Bug-hunt corpus: where the files come from (the files themselves are not kept in this repo).
# fetch_corpus.py downloads them; the sample inside a repo is fixed (sorted by sha1 of the path),
# so the same commit gives the same files.
# columns (tab separated): name  repo  commit  path-regex  max-files  max-bytes
#   repo "freecad" = the patched FreeCAD tree itself (--freecad-src), commit is ignored.
